title_zh: 暂缓采用虚构播客中的未证实指控

scenario.label_zh: 暂缓采用虚构播客中的未证实指控
scenario.goal_zh: 区分匿名内部人士说法与调查记录，并约定核对文件后再决定是否采用指控

context_zh: 虚构调查播客的编剧会议。人物、公司及调查材料均为创作练习设定，不涉及真实指控。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: In our fictional podcast, the factory is already infamous for the river spill. Can we add the claim about destroyed records?

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Who supports that claim in the story notes?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: An unnamed insider says a manager ordered the files to be shredded.

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: But the investigator's report says the files haven't been located. It doesn't say who removed them or why.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Then the insider gives us a lead, not proof.

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Right. The integrity of the episode depends on keeping that distinction. Let's check whether any document supports the order before we use the accusation.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll leave it out of this draft and check the source packet.
